tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand purple for fills and graphics only. Main buttons, the countdown ring, the add button, selected tab icon, the back chevron. Never for text, use primary-pressed. White text on it passes 5.4 to 1.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: The only purple for text, on any background. Links, Cancel and Back, the key phrase like 8 days left, Now, and text on primary-soft. Passes 6.9 to 1 or more everywhere.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Soft purple fill. Secondary button, the next trip circle, selected rows. Text on it uses primary-pressed.

tokens.name: ring-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of the countdown ring and the day dots.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Coral. Means pay attention. Ring fill in the last 5 days of a stay, warning icons. Never for text on light grounds.

tokens.name: secondary-ink
tokens.usage: The only coral for text, like a count close to its limit. Passes 4.9 to 1 on bg.

tokens.name: secondary-soft
tokens.usage: Very light background of the warning group. Barely tinted so it stays calm next to the cool palette. Text on it uses ink.

tokens.name: secondary-soft-ink
tokens.usage: Text inside a warning box on secondary-soft.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen background. Cool white so it sits with the purple.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Grouped rows, selected segment, cards in sheets.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and icons on bg and surface.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: All secondary text. Section headers, values on the right of rows, small notes, inactive tab. Passes 5.0 to 1 on bg and 4.7 to 1 on the current trip band.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows, row group borders, the segmented track.

tokens.name: control-off
tokens.usage: Outline of an empty list circle and chevrons. Decorative only, always paired with a text label.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Dimmed screen behind a sheet.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Screen titles, big numbers in circles, first open headline. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The key answer on a screen, like the leave by date or China.

styles.name: row
styles.usage: The country or name on the left of list rows. Semibold ink so it leads the row and stands apart from headers and values.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Values on the right of rows in muted, short paragraphs, warnings.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Every label. Section headers in lists and hero labels like NEXT TRIP. Muted, no line under.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Small notes and the date line under the sheet buttons.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related small items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a stack.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding inside grouped rows.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side margin on every screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections, and above the hero.

tokens.name: radius-group
tokens.usage: Grouped form rows and warning boxes. Things you read.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of a sheet.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, segmented switches, circles. Things you tap.

tokens.name: shadow-segment
tokens.usage: The selected thumb in a segmented switch.

tokens.name: size-button
tokens.usage: Height of main buttons.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a form row.

tokens.name: size-list-row
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a list row with two lines.

tokens.name: size-target
tokens.usage: Smallest tap area for any control.

tokens.name: size-fab
tokens.usage: Round add button.

tokens.name: size-ring
tokens.usage: Countdown ring and next trip circle.
